critical_correction.failure: structural-choice compression alone leaves the semantic assignment relation on the backdoor untouched
critical_correction.sanity: B=Var(F) is always a strong q-Horn backdoor, while its extendability relation is exactly Mod(F)
critical_correction.new_target: simultaneously compress structural carrier choices and assignment semantics with locally checkable coverage

BACKDOOR_DNF.positive: given a polynomial-size C-backdoor DNF and tractable C, SAT is polynomial in its size
BACKDOOR_DNF.negative: Horn union dual-Horn Backdoor DNF/Tree detection is W[2]-hard parameterized by terms/leaves; DNF coverage is a global tautology property

facts: DNNF and backdoor trees are special cases
PC-BDMC polynomially compiles to PC encoding
AND gates require disjoint variable supports
generic conjunction is not polynomial unless P=NP
efficient CNF-to-C-BDMC compilation is left as further research

QHORN_URC.fact: every q-Horn formula admits a polynomial-size URC encoding using auxiliary variables

csbc_gate_types.LEAF: recognized tractable native summary with exact poly operations
csbc_gate_types.DECISION: Shannon x=0/x=1 split with local exhaustive coverage
csbc_gate_types.DECOMP_AND: source-native BDMC conjunction on pairwise-disjoint supports
csbc_gate_types.BRIDGE_AND: overlapping conjunction only with pair-specific exact polynomial certificate
csbc_gate_types.PROJECT: allowed only under native polynomial exact forgetting/projection
